description: Abstract class for managing telemetry subscriptions, handling partition events, and asynchronous callback management within the Thingsboard server.

classes.name: AbstractSubscriptionService
classes.description: Abstract class for managing telemetry subscriptions, handling partition events, and asynchronous callback management within the Thingsboard server.

methods.name: initExecutor
methods.description: Initializes the executor service for WebSocket callbacks.

methods.name: shutdownExecutor
methods.description: Shuts down the executor service for WebSocket callbacks.

methods.name: onTbApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles partition change events to update current partitions.

methods.name: forwardToSubscriptionManagerService
methods.description: Forwards messages to the subscription manager service or cluster core based on partition ownership.

methods.name: addWsCallback
methods.description: Adds a callback to a ListenableFuture with WebSocket callback executor.

methods.name: addCallback
methods.description: Adds a callback to a ListenableFuture with specified executor.

methods.name: safeCallback
methods.description: Creates a safe callback consumer for handling failures.
